subtitle: Out Cebu · Philippine Airlines
overview: A Tokyo tour with a day around Mt. Fuji: Shibuya Crossing, Oishi Park and Lake Kawaguchi, a kimono experience and shopping at Gotemba Outlet. Visit Asakusa Temple and Tokyo Skytree, with free time in Shinjuku and a free day for an optional Disneyland trip. Fly Cebu – Narita and back with Philippine Airlines; stay in 4-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Mar 24–28 2027 to May 7–11 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Shibuya Crossing: Tokyo's famous scramble crossing, one of the busiest pedestrian crossings in the world.
placeDesc.Hachiko Statue: A bronze statue of the loyal dog Hachiko outside Shibuya Station, a popular meeting spot.
placeDesc.Oishi Park: A lakeside park at Lake Kawaguchi with views of Mt. Fuji and seasonal flowers.
placeDesc.Lake Kawaguchi: One of the Fuji Five Lakes, known for classic views of Mt. Fuji.
placeDesc.Gotemba Outlet: A large outlet shopping mall near Mt. Fuji for free shopping time.
placeDesc.Asakusa Temple: Senso-ji, Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, entered through the Kaminarimon gate.
placeDesc.Nakamise Shopping Street: A traditional shopping street leading to Asakusa Temple with snacks and souvenirs.
placeDesc.Tokyo Skytree: A tall broadcasting tower in Tokyo; the tour makes a photo stop.
placeDesc.Shinjuku: A busy Tokyo district of department stores and entertainment, used for free shopping time.
placeDesc.Disneyland: Optional free-day tour to the Disney theme park near Tokyo, with ticket and round-trip transfer.
